label: POSITIVE CONTROL — a second exposed land pattern with a candidate KNOWN answer
purpose: Decide whether pad counting is possible AT ALL in images/airtag/oflynn-airtag-tests.jpeg, by running the method against a land pattern whose answer is already published rather than against one that is unknown. Without this, the U2 refusal is only a tool declining to answer; with it, the refusal is demonstrated correct.

the_candidate_identification.claim: This second bare land pattern is the nRF52832-CIAA's.
the_candidate_identification.evidence_for: It sits adjacent to a gold-framed rectangular part of crystal proportions, which is exactly the nRF's neighbour relationship on the populated component side (oflynn-backside-fullres: the nRF is immediately beside the T320/RBEV crystal). Its array is of the right order of size.
the_candidate_identification.status: NOT ESTABLISHED. Positional consistency is not identification, and the conclusion below does not depend on it — see conclusion_holds_either_way.

the_known_answer_if_it_is_the_nRF.source: Nordic nRF52832 Product Specification v1.4 — Table 132 (WLCSP, 0.4 mm pitch) and the FICR PACKAGE field, which describes the CI package as 'CIxx - 7x8 WLCSP 56 balls'

the_seductive_result.why_it_is_seductive: 49 against a known 50 is a 2 % miss. Reported alone it would read as a validated method and a located part — turning U1 from SILICON SEEN into SILICON SEEN WITH ITS FOOTPRINT, and implicitly certifying the same method's answer for the Apple U1 module.

what_the_controls_did.reconciliation: FAIL — 49 blobs cannot sit on a 40-cell lattice. The two routes are irreconcilable, so at least one is measuring something other than this land pattern. The tool refused before the sweep was even reached.

verdict: CANNOT DETERMINE — and the method is demonstrated INCAPABLE at this resolution, not merely cautious.
conclusion_holds_either_way: If this IS the nRF land pattern, the method missed a known 7 x 8 shape in fifteen attempts and its count range spans an order of magnitude — so the 49 was luck. If it is NOT the nRF, then a 108 % count spread and fifteen lattice shapes condemn the measurement on their own. The identification does not need to be settled for the conclusion to stand.
why_the_near_hit_carries_no_information: 50 lies inside an observed range of 5 to 56. A prediction that cannot be missed is not confirmed by being hit. This is the same failure the coil measurement had — an agreement that could not have gone the other way — and it is why the near-hit is recorded here as a warning rather than as a result.
consequence: Pad counting from oflynn-airtag-tests.jpeg is CLOSED. No further quota should be spent on it by any lane. The U2 land-pattern refusal (bom/measurements/U2-landpattern.json) is upheld by a control with a known answer, which is stronger evidence than the U2 sweep alone.
what_would_reopen_it: Only a higher-resolution photograph of a depopulated component-side board. Enumerated 2026-09-05: O'Flynn's repository images/ holds eight files, seven images, all seven already in this project, and this is the only depopulated one.
